short: The German invasion of France and the Low Countries, leading to the rapid collapse of French forces.
full:
On 10 May 1940, Germany ended the "Phoney War" by launching a massive offensive against France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg. Using blitzkrieg tactics, German armoured units pushed through the Ardennes forest, bypassing the heavily fortified Maginot Line and cutting off the Allied armies in northern France and Belgium. This forced the dramatic evacuation of British and French forces from Dunkirk.

The swift destruction of the French army stunned the world. On 22 June, France signed an armistice with Germany, dividing the country into a German occupation zone in the north and west, and a collaborationist state in the south known as Vichy France. The defeat eliminated the primary Allied land power in Western Europe, leaving Britain to face Germany alone until 1941.
